#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# Copyright (C) 2026 Xiaomi Corporation
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# One-command runner for the remote agent control feature.
#
#   scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh build     compile goldfish with the feature on
#   scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh up        broker + bridge + emulator, linked up
#   scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh verify    automated end-to-end assertion
#   scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh attach    hand the device console to you
#   scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh down      stop everything, restore the tree
#
# MQTT credentials, if any, come only from REMOTE_MQTT_USERNAME and
# REMOTE_MQTT_PASSWORD. Never put a password on the command line: it shows up in
# the process list.

set -euo pipefail

script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
pkg_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
# Works from either packages/ai_agent/scripts or .worktrees/<wt>/scripts.
root_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/../../.." && pwd)

BOARD_CONFIG="vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap"
DEFCONFIG="$root_dir/$BOARD_CONFIG/defconfig"
BUILD_DIR="${REMOTE_CTRL_BUILD_DIR:-cmake_out/remote-ctrl-verify}"
IMAGE="$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR/nuttx"
BRIDGE_DIR="$root_dir/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/tools/acp-bridge"

# The system broker on 1883 usually demands auth, so the demo runs its own on a
# separate port. Loopback-only: goldfish reaches it through its NAT gateway
# (10.0.2.2) while nothing on the LAN can touch an anonymous broker.
BROKER_PORT="${REMOTE_CTRL_BROKER_PORT:-1884}"
DEVICE_ID="${REMOTE_CTRL_DEVICE_ID:-goldfish-1}"
TOPIC_PREFIX="${REMOTE_CTRL_TOPIC_PREFIX:-deskmate}"
BACKEND="${REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND:-fake}"
GUEST_HOST_GATEWAY="10.0.2.2"

TMUX_SESSION="remote-ctrl"
# Logs live under $HOME: files under /tmp have disappeared between steps on
# this machine.
STATE_DIR="$HOME/.remote-ctrl-demo"
EMU_LOG="$STATE_DIR/emulator.log"
BROKER_LOG="$STATE_DIR/broker.log"
BROKER_CONF="$STATE_DIR/broker.conf"
WIRE_LOG="$STATE_DIR/wire.log"
DEFCONFIG_BACKUP="$STATE_DIR/defconfig.orig"
COPIED_LIST="$STATE_DIR/copied-files.txt"

NSH_PROMPT="goldfish-armv8a-ap>"
AGENT_PROMPT="vela>"

say() { printf '\033[1m>> %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[33m!! %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; }
die() { printf '\033[31m** %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

usage() {
  sed -n '18,26p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
  cat <<EOF

Environment:
  REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND      fake (default) | mimo | kiro
  REMOTE_CTRL_BROKER_PORT  default $BROKER_PORT
  REMOTE_CTRL_DEVICE_ID    default $DEVICE_ID
  REMOTE_CTRL_BUILD_DIR    default $BUILD_DIR
  REMOTE_MQTT_USERNAME     broker credentials, never passed on argv
  REMOTE_MQTT_PASSWORD

Other subcommands:
  status    what is running right now
  wire      follow the live MQTT link traffic
  logs      follow the device log
EOF
}

# ── Tree preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

# apps/packages is a symlink to packages/, so a build always compiles
# packages/ai_agent — never a worktree. Feature code therefore has to be staged
# into packages/ai_agent, and taken back out by `down`.
stage_sources() {
  local target="$root_dir/packages/ai_agent"

  if [ "$pkg_dir" = "$target" ]; then
    say "sources already in packages/ai_agent, nothing to stage"
    : > "$COPIED_LIST"
    return 0
  fi

  git -C "$pkg_dir" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "$pkg_dir is not a git repo; cannot work out which files to stage"

  local base
  base=$(git -C "$pkg_dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>/dev/null || echo "work/next")

  local files
  files=$( { git -C "$pkg_dir" diff --name-only "$base";
             git -C "$pkg_dir" ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u )
  [ -n "$files" ] || die "no changes found in $pkg_dir versus $base"

  # Refuse to clobber someone else's uncommitted work in the target.
  local dirty
  dirty=$(git -C "$target" status --porcelain | wc -l)
  if [ "$dirty" -ne 0 ] && [ ! -f "$COPIED_LIST" ]; then
    git -C "$target" status --porcelain >&2
    die "packages/ai_agent has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them first"
  fi

  say "staging $(printf '%s\n' "$files" | wc -l) files into packages/ai_agent"
  : > "$COPIED_LIST"
  local f
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    mkdir -p "$target/$(dirname "$f")"
    cp -p "$pkg_dir/$f" "$target/$f"
    [ "$(md5sum < "$pkg_dir/$f")" = "$(md5sum < "$target/$f")" ] ||
      die "copy mismatch for $f"
    printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$COPIED_LIST"
  done <<< "$files"
}

unstage_sources() {
  local target="$root_dir/packages/ai_agent"

  [ -f "$COPIED_LIST" ] || return 0
  [ "$pkg_dir" = "$target" ] && { rm -f "$COPIED_LIST"; return 0; }

  say "removing staged files from packages/ai_agent"
  local f tracked=()
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    if git -C "$target" ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      tracked+=("$f")
    else
      rm -f "$target/$f"
    fi
  done < "$COPIED_LIST"

  [ ${#tracked[@]} -gt 0 ] && git -C "$target" checkout -- "${tracked[@]}"
  # Drop directories the staging created, but only if now empty.
  rmdir "$target/src/remote" "$target/tests/host" "$target/tests" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f "$COPIED_LIST"
}

# The board defconfig is shared and often carries uncommitted local edits, so it
# is restored from an exact byte copy rather than with `git checkout` — which
# would silently discard those edits.
enable_config() {
  grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$DEFCONFIG" && {
    say "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL already enabled"
    return 0
  }

  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] || cp -p "$DEFCONFIG" "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP"
  say "enabling CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL (backup: $DEFCONFIG_BACKUP)"
  # defconfig is savedefconfig output: keep it sorted.
  awk '
    /^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y$/ { next }
    !done && /^CONFIG_A/ && $0 > "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y" {
      print "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y"; done = 1
    }
    { print }
    END { if (!done) print "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y" }
  ' "$DEFCONFIG" > "$DEFCONFIG.tmp"
  mv "$DEFCONFIG.tmp" "$DEFCONFIG"
  grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$DEFCONFIG" || die "config insert failed"
}

restore_config() {
  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] || return 0
  say "restoring the board defconfig from backup"
  cp -p "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" "$DEFCONFIG"
  cmp -s "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" "$DEFCONFIG" || die "defconfig restore is not byte-identical"
  rm -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP"
}

# ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# "It compiled" is not evidence the feature is in the image: the build could
# have picked up a stale tree. Assert on the artifacts instead.
assert_image() {
  local out="$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR"
  [ -f "$out/nuttx" ] || die "no image at $out/nuttx — run 'build' first"

  grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$out/.config" ||
    die "the image was configured without CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL"

  local objects
  objects=$(find "$out" -path '*ai_agent*' \
    \( -name 'remote_*.c.o' -o -name 'tool_remote_agent.c.o' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  [ "$objects" -eq 6 ] || die "expected 6 remote-ctrl objects in the build, found $objects"

  local marker
  for marker in 'remote_agent_prompt' 'remote_agent_status' 'set_remote_auth' \
                'device-to-bridge' 'Prompt sent. Use remote_status'; do
    strings "$out/nuttx" | grep -qF "$marker" ||
      die "marker missing from the image: $marker"
  done

  say "image verified: config on, 6 objects, all markers present"
}

do_build() {
  command -v cmake > /dev/null || die "cmake not found"
  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  stage_sources
  enable_config
  say "building $BOARD_CONFIG into $BUILD_DIR (a few minutes)"
  ( cd "$root_dir" && ./build.sh "$BOARD_CONFIG/" --cmake -b "$BUILD_DIR" -j"$(nproc)" )
  assert_image
  say "build done. Next: $0 up"
}

# ── Services ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

broker_running() { ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$BROKER_PORT "; }

start_broker() {
  broker_running && { say "broker already listening on $BROKER_PORT"; return 0; }
  command -v mosquitto > /dev/null || die "mosquitto not installed"
  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  cat > "$BROKER_CONF" <<EOF
# Demo broker for the remote-ctrl feature. Loopback only: the emulator reaches
# it via its NAT gateway, while nothing on the LAN can use an open broker.
listener $BROKER_PORT 127.0.0.1
allow_anonymous true
EOF
  say "starting broker on 127.0.0.1:$BROKER_PORT"
  setsid nohup mosquitto -c "$BROKER_CONF" > "$BROKER_LOG" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  disown || true
  local i
  for i in $(seq 1 20); do broker_running && return 0; sleep 0.5; done
  cat "$BROKER_LOG" >&2
  die "broker did not come up"
}

start_bridge() {
  [ -d "$BRIDGE_DIR" ] || die "acp-bridge not found at $BRIDGE_DIR"
  [ -d "$BRIDGE_DIR/node_modules" ] || die "run 'npm install' in $BRIDGE_DIR first"

  local cmd="cd $BRIDGE_DIR && node bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs"
  cmd+=" --backend $BACKEND --transport mqtt"
  cmd+=" --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:$BROKER_PORT"
  cmd+=" --topic-prefix $TOPIC_PREFIX --device-id $DEVICE_ID"

  say "starting bridge (backend=$BACKEND) in tmux window 'bridge'"
  tmux new-window -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n bridge "$cmd; exec ${SHELL:-/bin/bash}"
  sleep 5
  tmux list-windows -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -F '#W' | grep -qx bridge ||
    die "bridge window died on startup"
}

# Waits for a string to show up in the device log.
wait_for() {
  local needle="$1" timeout="$2" i
  for i in $(seq 1 "$timeout"); do
    grep -qF "$needle" "$EMU_LOG" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}

start_device() {
  assert_image
  pgrep -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" > /dev/null &&
    die "an emulator is already running; run '$0 down' first"

  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  : > "$EMU_LOG"
  # tee keeps the console echoing in tmux while also giving a greppable log.
  local cmd="cd $root_dir && ./emulator.sh $BUILD_DIR -no-window 2>&1 | tee $EMU_LOG"
  say "starting emulator in tmux window 'device'"
  tmux new-window -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n device "$cmd; exec ${SHELL:-/bin/bash}"

  wait_for "$NSH_PROMPT" 90 || die "no NSH prompt after 90s; see $EMU_LOG"
  say "NSH is up"

  # ai_agent MUST stay in the foreground. Backgrounded, NSH keeps stdin and the
  # agent's own commands never see your input.
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "ai_agent" Enter
  wait_for "$AGENT_PROMPT" 60 || die "agent did not reach its prompt; see $EMU_LOG"
  say "agent is up"

  # Credentials go through the config store, never argv.
  if [ -n "${REMOTE_MQTT_USERNAME:-}" ]; then
    tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" \
      "set_remote_auth $REMOTE_MQTT_USERNAME ${REMOTE_MQTT_PASSWORD:-}" Enter
    sleep 3
  fi

  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" \
    "set_remote $GUEST_HOST_GATEWAY:$BROKER_PORT $DEVICE_ID" Enter

  wait_for "connected as $DEVICE_ID" 30 || {
    tail -30 "$EMU_LOG" >&2
    die "device did not connect to the broker; see $EMU_LOG"
  }
  say "device linked to the bridge"
}

ensure_session() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  tmux new-session -d -s "$TMUX_SESSION" -x 220 -y 50 -n shell
}

do_up() {
  command -v tmux > /dev/null || die "tmux not installed"
  ensure_session
  start_broker
  start_bridge
  start_device
  cat <<EOF

$(say "everything is up")

  device console : tmux attach -t $TMUX_SESSION \; select-window -t device
  bridge console : tmux attach -t $TMUX_SESSION \; select-window -t bridge
  or just        : $0 attach

Try this at the device's 'vela>' prompt:

  remote_status                 link state, billing, pending approval
  remote_ask what changed here  send one instruction to the remote agent
  remote_output                 the remote agent's reply so far

Permission flow (bridge drops the request after 30s, so do it in one go):

  1. bridge window: prompt
  2. device window: remote_status     -> State: Attention
  3. device window: remote_once       -> "Permission decision accepted by ACP"

  $0 verify   runs exactly that, automatically
  $0 wire     shows the raw MQTT messages
  $0 down     stops everything and restores the tree
EOF
}

# ── Verify ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Drives the one flow that proves the whole stack: a human-only approval that
# has to reach the ACP backend and come back as authority.
do_verify() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || die "nothing running; run '$0 up' first"
  local mark
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")

  say "1/4 asking the device for status"
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_status" Enter
  sleep 4
  tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG" | grep -q 'Chat turns: yes' ||
    die "the bridge is not offering chat turns; is it running?"

  say "2/4 sending a prompt from the device"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_ask list what changed" Enter
  sleep 6
  tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG" | grep -q 'Prompt sent' ||
    die "the prompt was refused locally"

  say "3/4 triggering a permission request on the bridge"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:bridge" "prompt" Enter
  sleep 4
  tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG" | grep -q 'approval required' ||
    die "the device never saw the permission request"

  say "4/4 approving it on the device"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_once" Enter
  sleep 6
  local out
  out=$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")
  grep -q 'Approved once' <<< "$out" || die "the decision was refused locally"
  # Written only after the bridge's adapter.respondPermission() succeeds, so it
  # is proof the decision reached the ACP backend.
  grep -q 'Permission decision accepted by ACP' <<< "$out" ||
    die "the ACP backend never confirmed the decision"

  # The latch must refuse a second decision on the same prompt.
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_once" Enter
  sleep 4
  tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG" | grep -q 'No approvable request is pending' ||
    warn "the decision latch did not refuse a repeat decision — check by hand"

  cat <<EOF

$(say "end to end verified")
  handshake      device hello -> bridge hello_ack (chat_turns)
  authority      snapshots accepted, epoch locked
  outbound       prompt_submit reached the bridge
  permission     human approval reached the ACP backend and came back
  latch          a repeat decision was refused locally
EOF
}

# ── Small helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

do_status() {
  printf 'broker  :%s\n' "$(broker_running && echo " up on 127.0.0.1:$BROKER_PORT" || echo ' down')"
  printf 'bridge  :%s\n' "$(pgrep -f "[d]eskmate-bridge.mjs" > /dev/null && echo ' up' || echo ' down')"
  printf 'emulator:%s\n' "$(pgrep -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" > /dev/null && echo ' up' || echo ' down')"
  printf 'tmux    :%s\n' "$(tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null && echo " session $TMUX_SESSION" || echo ' none')"
  if [ -f "$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" ]; then
    printf 'image   : %s (%s)\n' "$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" "$(date -r "$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" '+%F %T')"
  else
    printf 'image   : not built\n'
  fi
  [ -f "$COPIED_LIST" ] && printf 'staged  : %s files in packages/ai_agent\n' "$(wc -l < "$COPIED_LIST")"
  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] && printf 'defconfig: modified (backup kept)\n'
  return 0
}

do_wire() {
  broker_running || die "broker is not running"
  say "following $TOPIC_PREFIX/# — Ctrl-C to stop"
  exec mosquitto_sub -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$BROKER_PORT" -t "$TOPIC_PREFIX/#" -v
}

do_attach() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || die "nothing running; run '$0 up' first"
  exec tmux attach -t "$TMUX_SESSION" \; select-window -t device
}

do_down() {
  say "stopping the emulator"
  pkill -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" 2>/dev/null || true
  say "stopping the bridge"
  pkill -f "[d]eskmate-bridge.mjs" 2>/dev/null || true
  if broker_running && [ -f "$BROKER_CONF" ]; then
    say "stopping the demo broker"
    # Match the config path so the system broker on 1883 is left alone.
    pkill -f "mosquitto -c $BROKER_CONF" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  pkill -x mosquitto_sub 2>/dev/null || true
  tmux kill-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || true
  restore_config
  unstage_sources
  say "stopped. The built image stays in $BUILD_DIR"
}

case "${1:-}" in
  build) do_build ;;
  up) do_up ;;
  verify) do_verify ;;
  attach) do_attach ;;
  status) do_status ;;
  wire) do_wire ;;
  logs) exec tail -f "$EMU_LOG" ;;
  broker) start_broker; say "broker up; Ctrl-C here is safe, it runs detached" ;;
  bridge) ensure_session; start_bridge ;;
  device) ensure_session; start_device ;;
  down) do_down ;;
  ""|-h|--help|help) usage ;;
  *) printf 'unknown command: %s\n\n' "$1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/usr/bin/env bash

#
# One-command runner for the remote agent control feature. Defaults match the
# established DeskMate workflow: the host's LAN broker on 1883, a real `mimo`
# ACP backend, and `mimo attach` opened alongside.
#
# The PC half is delegated to tools/acp-bridge/bin/deskmate-demo.sh rather than
# reimplemented; what this script adds is the device half — building the image,
# booting the emulator, and pointing the agent at the bridge.

set -euo pipefail

script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
pkg_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
# Resolves from either packages/ai_agent/scripts or .worktrees/<wt>/scripts.
root_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/../../.." && pwd)

BOARD_CONFIG="vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap"
DEFCONFIG="$root_dir/$BOARD_CONFIG/defconfig"
BUILD_DIR="${REMOTE_CTRL_BUILD_DIR:-cmake_out/remote-ctrl-verify}"
BRIDGE_DIR="$root_dir/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/tools/acp-bridge"
DEMO_SH="$BRIDGE_DIR/bin/deskmate-demo.sh"

# The device must reach the broker by an address that means "the PC" from inside
# the emulator. A LAN address works (QEMU user-mode NAT routes outbound), and it
# is what the DeskMate flow already uses. 10.0.2.2, the NAT gateway, is the
# fallback when the host has no LAN address.
detect_host_address() {
  ip -4 addr show scope global 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'inet \K[\d.]+' | head -1
}

HOST_ADDRESS="${REMOTE_CTRL_HOST_ADDRESS:-$(detect_host_address)}"
HOST_ADDRESS="${HOST_ADDRESS:-10.0.2.2}"
BROKER_PORT="${REMOTE_CTRL_BROKER_PORT:-1883}"
DEVICE_ID="${REMOTE_CTRL_DEVICE_ID:-goldfish-1}"
TOPIC_PREFIX="${REMOTE_CTRL_TOPIC_PREFIX:-deskmate}"
BACKEND="${REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND:-mimo}"
MIMO_ATTACH="${REMOTE_CTRL_MIMO_ATTACH:-1}"
MIMO_ATTACH_PORT="${REMOTE_CTRL_MIMO_ATTACH_PORT:-4096}"

# Credentials are shared with the DeskMate flow so one pair of exports covers
# both. They are never passed on this script's command line.
MQTT_USERNAME="${DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME:-${REMOTE_MQTT_USERNAME:-}}"
MQTT_PASSWORD="${DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD:-${REMOTE_MQTT_PASSWORD:-}}"

TMUX_SESSION="${REMOTE_CTRL_TMUX_SESSION:-remote-ctrl}"
# State under $HOME: files written to /tmp have vanished between steps on this
# machine.
STATE_DIR="$HOME/.remote-ctrl-demo"
EMU_LOG="$STATE_DIR/emulator.log"
BROKER_LOG="$STATE_DIR/broker.log"
BROKER_CONF="$STATE_DIR/broker.conf"
DEFCONFIG_BACKUP="$STATE_DIR/defconfig.orig"
COPIED_LIST="$STATE_DIR/copied-files.txt"

NSH_PROMPT="goldfish-armv8a-ap>"
AGENT_PROMPT="vela>"

say() { printf '\033[1m>> %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf '\033[33m!! %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; }
die() { printf '\033[31m** %s\033[0m\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
One-command runner for the remote agent control feature.

  $(basename "$0") build     compile goldfish with the feature enabled
  $(basename "$0") up        bridge + mimo attach + emulator, linked up
  $(basename "$0") verify    automated end-to-end assertion
  $(basename "$0") attach    hand the device console to you
  $(basename "$0") down      stop everything and restore the tree

Typical session:

  export DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME=deskmate
  export DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD=...
  $(basename "$0") build
  $(basename "$0") up

Current defaults:
  broker    mqtt://$HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT   (device dials the same address)
  backend   $BACKEND$([ "$MIMO_ATTACH" = 1 ] && printf ' with mimo attach on port %s' "$MIMO_ATTACH_PORT")
  device    $DEVICE_ID
  image     $BUILD_DIR

Environment:
  DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME / DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD   broker credentials
  REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND          mimo (default) | kiro | fake
  REMOTE_CTRL_HOST_ADDRESS     address the device dials (default $HOST_ADDRESS)
  REMOTE_CTRL_BROKER_PORT      default $BROKER_PORT
  REMOTE_CTRL_DEVICE_ID        default $DEVICE_ID
  REMOTE_CTRL_MIMO_ATTACH      1 (default) | 0
  REMOTE_CTRL_MIMO_ATTACH_PORT default $MIMO_ATTACH_PORT
  REMOTE_CTRL_BUILD_DIR        default $BUILD_DIR

Other subcommands:
  status    what is running right now
  wire      follow the live MQTT link traffic
  logs      follow the device log
  broker    start a local anonymous broker (only if you have none)
EOF
}

# ── Tree preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

# apps/packages is a symlink to packages/, so any build compiles
# packages/ai_agent and never a worktree. Feature code is therefore staged in,
# and taken back out by `down`.
stage_sources() {
  local target="$root_dir/packages/ai_agent"

  if [ "$pkg_dir" = "$target" ]; then
    say "sources already live in packages/ai_agent, nothing to stage"
    mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"; : > "$COPIED_LIST"
    return 0
  fi

  git -C "$pkg_dir" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 ||
    die "$pkg_dir is not a git repo, so the file set cannot be determined"

  local base
  base=$(git -C "$pkg_dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref '@{upstream}' 2>/dev/null || echo "work/next")

  local files
  files=$( { git -C "$pkg_dir" diff --name-only "$base";
             git -C "$pkg_dir" ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u )
  [ -n "$files" ] || die "no changes found in $pkg_dir versus $base"

  # Never clobber someone else's uncommitted work in the shared package.
  if [ ! -f "$COPIED_LIST" ] && [ "$(git -C "$target" status --porcelain | wc -l)" -ne 0 ]; then
    git -C "$target" status --porcelain >&2
    die "packages/ai_agent has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them first"
  fi

  say "staging $(printf '%s\n' "$files" | wc -l) files into packages/ai_agent"
  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"; : > "$COPIED_LIST"
  local f
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    mkdir -p "$target/$(dirname "$f")"
    cp -p "$pkg_dir/$f" "$target/$f"
    cmp -s "$pkg_dir/$f" "$target/$f" || die "copy mismatch for $f"
    printf '%s\n' "$f" >> "$COPIED_LIST"
  done <<< "$files"
}

unstage_sources() {
  local target="$root_dir/packages/ai_agent"

  [ -f "$COPIED_LIST" ] || return 0
  if [ "$pkg_dir" = "$target" ]; then rm -f "$COPIED_LIST"; return 0; fi

  say "removing staged files from packages/ai_agent"
  local f tracked=()
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
    if git -C "$target" ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      tracked+=("$f")
    else
      rm -f "$target/$f"
    fi
  done < "$COPIED_LIST"

  [ ${#tracked[@]} -gt 0 ] && git -C "$target" checkout -- "${tracked[@]}"
  rmdir "$target/src/remote" "$target/tests/host" "$target/tests" 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -f "$COPIED_LIST"
}

# The board defconfig is shared and routinely carries uncommitted local edits,
# so it is restored from an exact byte copy. `git checkout` would silently throw
# those edits away.
enable_config() {
  if grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$DEFCONFIG"; then
    say "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL already enabled"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] || cp -p "$DEFCONFIG" "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP"
  say "enabling CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL (backup at $DEFCONFIG_BACKUP)"
  # defconfig is savedefconfig output, so keep it sorted.
  awk '
    !inserted && /^CONFIG_A/ && $0 > "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y" {
      print "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y"; inserted = 1
    }
    { print }
    END { if (!inserted) print "CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y" }
  ' "$DEFCONFIG" > "$DEFCONFIG.tmp"
  mv "$DEFCONFIG.tmp" "$DEFCONFIG"
  grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$DEFCONFIG" || die "config insert failed"
}

restore_config() {
  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] || return 0
  say "restoring the board defconfig from its backup"
  cp -p "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" "$DEFCONFIG"
  cmp -s "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" "$DEFCONFIG" || die "defconfig restore is not byte-identical"
  rm -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP"
}

# ── Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# "It compiled" is not evidence the feature is in the image — a build can pick
# up a stale tree. Assert on the artifacts instead.
assert_image() {
  local out="$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR"
  [ -f "$out/nuttx" ] || die "no image at $out/nuttx — run 'build' first"

  grep -q '^CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y' "$out/.config" ||
    die "this image was configured without CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL"

  local objects
  objects=$(find "$out" -path '*ai_agent*' \
    \( -name 'remote_*.c.o' -o -name 'tool_remote_agent.c.o' \) 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  [ "$objects" -eq 6 ] || die "expected 6 remote-ctrl objects, found $objects"

  local marker
  for marker in 'remote_agent_prompt' 'remote_agent_status' 'set_remote_auth' \
                'device-to-bridge' 'Prompt sent. Use remote_status'; do
    strings "$out/nuttx" | grep -qF "$marker" || die "marker missing from image: $marker"
  done

  say "image verified: config on, 6 objects, all markers present"
}

do_build() {
  command -v cmake > /dev/null || die "cmake not found"
  stage_sources
  enable_config
  say "building $BOARD_CONFIG into $BUILD_DIR (a few minutes)"
  ( cd "$root_dir" && ./build.sh "$BOARD_CONFIG/" --cmake -b "$BUILD_DIR" -j"$(nproc)" )
  assert_image
  say "build done. Next: $(basename "$0") up"
}

# ── Services ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

broker_reachable() {
  timeout 5 mosquitto_pub -h "$HOST_ADDRESS" -p "$BROKER_PORT" \
    ${MQTT_USERNAME:+-u "$MQTT_USERNAME"} ${MQTT_PASSWORD:+-P "$MQTT_PASSWORD"} \
    -t "$TOPIC_PREFIX/_probe" -m probe > /dev/null 2>&1
}

check_broker() {
  command -v mosquitto_pub > /dev/null || { warn "mosquitto_pub absent, skipping the broker probe"; return 0; }
  if broker_reachable; then
    say "broker reachable at $HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT"
    return 0
  fi
  warn "cannot publish to $HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT with the supplied credentials"
  warn "export DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME / DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD, or run '$(basename "$0") broker'"
  die "broker check failed"
}

# Only for machines with no broker of their own. Loopback-bound and anonymous,
# so nothing on the LAN can reach it; the device must then dial 10.0.2.2.
start_broker() {
  command -v mosquitto > /dev/null || die "mosquitto not installed"
  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  cat > "$BROKER_CONF" <<EOF
# Local fallback broker for the remote-ctrl demo. Loopback only and anonymous:
# the emulator reaches it through its NAT gateway (10.0.2.2) while nothing on
# the LAN can use it.
listener ${REMOTE_CTRL_LOCAL_BROKER_PORT:-1884} 127.0.0.1
allow_anonymous true
EOF
  say "starting a local broker on 127.0.0.1:${REMOTE_CTRL_LOCAL_BROKER_PORT:-1884}"
  setsid nohup mosquitto -c "$BROKER_CONF" > "$BROKER_LOG" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
  disown || true
  sleep 2
  ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${REMOTE_CTRL_LOCAL_BROKER_PORT:-1884} " || {
    cat "$BROKER_LOG" >&2; die "local broker did not start"
  }
  cat <<EOF

Point the demo at it with:
  export REMOTE_CTRL_HOST_ADDRESS=10.0.2.2
  export REMOTE_CTRL_BROKER_PORT=${REMOTE_CTRL_LOCAL_BROKER_PORT:-1884}
  unset DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD
EOF
}

# The PC half, including the mimo-attach handshake, is deskmate-demo.sh's job.
start_bridge() {
  [ -x "$DEMO_SH" ] || die "not found or not executable: $DEMO_SH"
  [ -d "$BRIDGE_DIR/node_modules" ] || die "run 'npm install' in $BRIDGE_DIR first"
  if [ "$BACKEND" = "mimo" ]; then
    command -v "${DESKMATE_MIMO_BIN:-mimo}" > /dev/null ||
      die "the mimo backend needs '${DESKMATE_MIMO_BIN:-mimo}' on PATH"
  fi

  local cmd="cd $BRIDGE_DIR && bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge $BACKEND mqtt"
  cmd+=" --broker mqtt://$HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT"
  cmd+=" --topic-prefix $TOPIC_PREFIX --device-id $DEVICE_ID"
  if [ "$MIMO_ATTACH" = 1 ] && [ "$BACKEND" = "mimo" ]; then
    cmd+=" --mimo-attach --mimo-attach-port $MIMO_ATTACH_PORT"
  fi

  say "starting the bridge (backend=$BACKEND) via deskmate-demo.sh"
  # Run it inside tmux so its own --mimo-attach path can open a window for the
  # attach session.
  tmux new-window -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n bridge "$cmd; exec ${SHELL:-/bin/bash}"

  local i
  for i in $(seq 1 40); do
    pgrep -f "[d]eskmate-bridge.mjs" > /dev/null && { say "bridge is up"; sleep 3; return 0; }
    sleep 1
  done
  tmux capture-pane -t "$TMUX_SESSION:bridge" -p | tail -20 >&2
  die "the bridge did not start"
}

wait_for() {
  local needle="$1" timeout="$2" i
  for i in $(seq 1 "$timeout"); do
    grep -qF "$needle" "$EMU_LOG" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}

start_device() {
  assert_image
  pgrep -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" > /dev/null &&
    die "an emulator is already running; '$(basename "$0") down' first"

  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  : > "$EMU_LOG"
  # tee keeps the console interactive in tmux and still leaves a greppable log.
  local cmd="cd $root_dir && ./emulator.sh $BUILD_DIR -no-window 2>&1 | tee $EMU_LOG"
  say "booting the emulator"
  tmux new-window -t "$TMUX_SESSION" -n device "$cmd; exec ${SHELL:-/bin/bash}"

  wait_for "$NSH_PROMPT" 120 || die "no NSH prompt within 120s, see $EMU_LOG"
  say "NSH is up"

  # ai_agent must stay in the FOREGROUND. Backgrounded, NSH keeps stdin and the
  # agent's own commands never see any input.
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "ai_agent" Enter
  wait_for "$AGENT_PROMPT" 90 || die "the agent never reached its prompt, see $EMU_LOG"
  say "agent is up"

  # Credentials reach the device through its config store. Note they do travel
  # over this one NSH command line, which is visible in the guest's own process
  # list — acceptable for simulator bring-up, not for a shipped device.
  if [ -n "$MQTT_USERNAME" ]; then
    say "setting broker credentials on the device"
    tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" \
      "set_remote_auth $MQTT_USERNAME $MQTT_PASSWORD" Enter
    sleep 4
  fi

  say "pointing the device at $HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT"
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" \
    "set_remote $HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT $DEVICE_ID" Enter

  wait_for "connected as $DEVICE_ID" 40 || {
    tail -30 "$EMU_LOG" >&2
    die "the device did not reach the broker, see $EMU_LOG"
  }
  say "device is linked to the bridge"
}

ensure_session() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  tmux new-session -d -s "$TMUX_SESSION" -x 220 -y 50 -n shell
}

do_up() {
  command -v tmux > /dev/null || die "tmux not installed"
  ensure_session
  check_broker
  start_bridge
  start_device

  cat <<EOF

$(say "everything is up")

  console  : $(basename "$0") attach          (device window; 'vela>' prompt)
  windows  : tmux attach -t $TMUX_SESSION
  traffic  : $(basename "$0") wire
  teardown : $(basename "$0") down

At the device's 'vela>' prompt:

  remote_status                  link state, billing, whether approval is pending
  remote_ask <instruction>       send one instruction to the remote agent
  remote_output                  the remote agent's reply so far
  remote_once / remote_deny      answer a permission request (human only)

EOF
  if [ "$BACKEND" = "fake" ]; then
    cat <<EOF
Permission flow with the fake backend (the bridge drops the request after 30s,
so do it in one go):

  1. bridge window: prompt
  2. device window: remote_status   -> State: Attention
  3. device window: remote_once     -> "Permission decision accepted by ACP"

  $(basename "$0") verify   does exactly that, automatically
EOF
  else
    cat <<EOF
With the $BACKEND backend, permission requests appear when the agent really
wants to run a tool, so ask for something that touches the PC:

  remote_ask run git status in this repo

Then answer on the device with remote_once or remote_deny within 30 seconds.

  $(basename "$0") verify   checks handshake and prompt delivery
EOF
  fi
}

# ── Verify ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

do_verify() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || die "nothing running; '$(basename "$0") up' first"
  [ -f "$EMU_LOG" ] || die "no device log at $EMU_LOG"
  local mark out

  say "1/3 device status"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_status" Enter
  sleep 5
  out=$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")
  grep -q 'Chat turns: yes' <<< "$out" ||
    die "the bridge is not advertising chat turns; is it connected?"
  say "    handshake ok: snapshots accepted, chat turns offered"

  say "2/3 outbound prompt"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_ask summarise what this repo is" Enter
  sleep 8
  out=$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")
  grep -q 'Prompt sent' <<< "$out" || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; die "the prompt was refused locally"; }
  say "    prompt_submit reached the bridge"

  if [ "$BACKEND" != "fake" ]; then
    cat <<EOF

$(say "verified as far as this backend allows")
  handshake   device hello -> bridge hello_ack (chat_turns)
  authority   snapshots accepted, epoch locked
  outbound    prompt_submit delivered to the bridge

The permission path needs a real tool call from the $BACKEND agent, which cannot
be forced from here. Drive it by hand:

  device window: remote_ask run git status in this repo
  device window: remote_status      -> State: Attention, with the tool named
  device window: remote_once        -> "Permission decision accepted by ACP"

Or re-run the whole thing against the deterministic backend:

  REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND=fake $(basename "$0") down && REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND=fake $(basename "$0") up
  REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND=fake $(basename "$0") verify
EOF
    return 0
  fi

  say "3/3 permission round trip"
  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:bridge" "prompt" Enter
  sleep 5
  grep -q 'approval required' <<< "$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")" ||
    die "the device never saw the permission request"

  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_once" Enter
  sleep 7
  out=$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")
  grep -q 'Approved once' <<< "$out" || die "the decision was refused locally"
  # Written only after the bridge's adapter.respondPermission() succeeds, so it
  # is proof the decision reached the ACP backend.
  grep -q 'Permission decision accepted by ACP' <<< "$out" ||
    die "the ACP backend never confirmed the decision"

  mark=$(wc -c < "$EMU_LOG")
  tmux send-keys -t "$TMUX_SESSION:device" "remote_once" Enter
  sleep 5
  grep -q 'No approvable request is pending' <<< "$(tail -c "+$((mark + 1))" "$EMU_LOG")" ||
    warn "the decision latch did not refuse a repeat decision — check by hand"

  cat <<EOF

$(say "end to end verified")
  handshake    device hello -> bridge hello_ack (chat_turns)
  authority    snapshots accepted, epoch locked
  outbound     prompt_submit delivered to the bridge
  permission   human approval reached the ACP backend and came back as authority
  latch        a repeat decision was refused locally
EOF
}

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

do_status() {
  printf 'bridge   : %s\n' "$(pgrep -f "[d]eskmate-bridge.mjs" > /dev/null && echo up || echo down)"
  printf 'emulator : %s\n' "$(pgrep -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" > /dev/null && echo up || echo down)"
  printf 'tmux     : %s\n' "$(tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null && echo "session $TMUX_SESSION" || echo none)"
  printf 'broker   : %s\n' "$HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT${MQTT_USERNAME:+ (user $MQTT_USERNAME)}"
  if [ -f "$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" ]; then
    printf 'image    : %s (%s)\n' "$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" "$(date -r "$root_dir/$BUILD_DIR/nuttx" '+%F %T')"
  else
    printf 'image    : not built\n'
  fi
  [ -f "$COPIED_LIST" ] && printf 'staged   : %s files in packages/ai_agent\n' "$(wc -l < "$COPIED_LIST")"
  [ -f "$DEFCONFIG_BACKUP" ] && printf 'defconfig: modified, backup kept\n'
  return 0
}

do_wire() {
  command -v mosquitto_sub > /dev/null || die "mosquitto_sub not installed"
  say "following $TOPIC_PREFIX/# on $HOST_ADDRESS:$BROKER_PORT — Ctrl-C to stop"
  exec mosquitto_sub -h "$HOST_ADDRESS" -p "$BROKER_PORT" \
    ${MQTT_USERNAME:+-u "$MQTT_USERNAME"} ${MQTT_PASSWORD:+-P "$MQTT_PASSWORD"} \
    -t "$TOPIC_PREFIX/#" -v
}

do_attach() {
  tmux has-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || die "nothing running; '$(basename "$0") up' first"
  exec tmux attach -t "$TMUX_SESSION" \; select-window -t device
}

do_down() {
  say "stopping the emulator"
  pkill -f "[q]emu-system-aarch64" 2>/dev/null || true
  say "stopping the bridge"
  pkill -f "[d]eskmate-bridge.mjs" 2>/dev/null || true
  # Only ever the demo's own broker: matching the config path leaves the
  # system broker on 1883 alone.
  if [ -f "$BROKER_CONF" ]; then
    pkill -f "mosquitto -c $BROKER_CONF" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  pkill -x mosquitto_sub 2>/dev/null || true
  tmux kill-session -t "$TMUX_SESSION" 2>/dev/null || true
  restore_config
  unstage_sources
  say "stopped. The built image stays in $BUILD_DIR"
}

case "${1:-}" in
  build) do_build ;;
  up) do_up ;;
  verify) do_verify ;;
  attach) do_attach ;;
  status) do_status ;;
  wire) do_wire ;;
  logs) [ -f "$EMU_LOG" ] || die "no log yet"; exec tail -f "$EMU_LOG" ;;
  broker) start_broker ;;
  bridge) ensure_session; start_bridge ;;
  device) ensure_session; start_device ;;
  down) do_down ;;
  ""|-h|--help|help) usage ;;
  *) printf 'unknown command: %s\n\n' "$1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

input.new_string:
# The strings output is cached rather than re-piped per marker. Piping strings
  # of a ~230 MB image straight into `grep -q` lets grep exit first, killing
  # strings with SIGPIPE, which `set -o pipefail` then reports as a failure even
  # though the marker was found.
  local strings_file="$STATE_DIR/image-strings.txt"
  mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
  strings "$out/nuttx" > "$strings_file"

  local marker
  for marker in 'remote_agent_prompt' 'remote_agent_status' 'set_remote_auth' \
                'device-to-bridge' 'Prompt sent. Use remote_status'; do
    grep -qF "$marker" "$strings_file" || {
      rm -f "$strings_file"
      die "marker missing from image: $marker"
    }
  done
  rm -f "$strings_file"

## Goal

把 `contest2026_272_tokenwujixian` 里的板上 app `app/deskmate` 转成 `packages/ai_agent` 的一个新 feature——远程控制能力（remote control），让设备作为客户端连接远端跑 ACP 的 agent（mimocode / kiro-cli）。当前收尾目标：提供一个「几条命令就能真实运行」的一键脚本，形态对齐用户原来跑 deskmate 的方式。

## Instructions

- **能力形态**：通道 + 工具，但**权限决策只允许人工**。`remote_once` / `remote_deny` 只能从 NSH 命令（及将来 GPIO 按键）触达，**绝不注册为 LLM 可调用的 tool**——批准远端 agent 的工具调用是人的行为，模型若能同时请求又批准，权限模型就形同装饰。代码注释和 tool description 里都要钉住这条。
- **链路形态**：保留 DeskMate Link（设备 —MQTT→ PC bridge —stdio→ ACP agent），不做设备直连 ACP。
- **代码落地**：`packages/ai_agent` 本地 feature 分支，Kconfig `default n`，不推 upstream。
- **验证方式**：用 vela 的编译方式编 goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap + 模拟器 + `tools/acp-bridge` 的 PC 侧工具做端到端验证。
- **一键脚本要对齐用户真实用法**：局域网 IP + 现有 1883 broker（凭据 `deskmate` / `5006`）+ 真 mimo 后端 + `--mimo-attach --mimo-attach-port 4096`。用户原来的做法是主机跑 `bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge mimo mqtt --broker mqtt://10.189.140.244:1883 --device-id goldfish-1 --mimo-attach --mimo-attach-port 4096`，设备侧跑 `deskmate -h 10.189.140.244 -p 1883 -u deskmate -w 5006 -d goldfish-1`。
- 凭据只走环境变量（`DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME` / `DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD`），不放命令行。

## Discoveries

**架构判断（几轮往复后的结论）**：ACP 的设计前提（稳定 stdio 管道、无界消息、阻塞式双向）与跑在 WiFi 上的受限设备三条全冲。`mcp_client.c`（纯出向）、`mcp_server.c`（同步应答、仅 stdio）、`node_client.c`（从不回复入向）三种既有形状都不满足 ACP 需要的「双向 peer + 待答入向请求表」。Link 正是那层适配，bridge 把双向性吞掉，设备侧只剩「收快照 + 发决策」，与 `node_client` 已有形状一致。`kiro-cli acp` 只有 stdio、无任何监听参数。

**MQTT-C 锁序反转（已修）**：`__mqtt_recv` 从 657 行持 `client->mutex` 直到 775 行调 `publish_response_callback`，NuttX 上该 PAL mutex 是真 `pthread_mutex_t`（`mqtt_pal.h:86`）。入向 = MQTT锁→会话锁，出向 `mqtt_publish` = 会话锁→MQTT锁，ABBA 会挂死。解法：锁内构造消息、释放锁、再发送（`mqtt_channel.c` 同规矩）。

**其他已修缺陷**：控制台自锁（`remote_ask` 若阻塞等 turn，远端请求权限时用户打不出 `remote_once`——控制台走非阻塞 submit，只有 tool 路径阻塞）；重启竞态（detached 线程 + 静态 `g_mqtt`，加所有权 guard）；`request_id` 白烧（前置检查须排在发号之前）。

**端到端已验证通过**（有抓包与两侧日志证据）：握手 `hello → hello_ack(chat_turns) → snapshot(seq 1) → usage_snapshot → snapshot(seq 2,3)`，seq 严格递增、epoch 一致、重连换新 nonce；权限回路闭合——设备 `approval required` → `remote_once` → 线上 `{"cmd":"permission",...}` → 设备收到 `Permission decision accepted by ACP`（该串来自 `bridge-core.js:139`，只在 `adapter.respondPermission()` 成功后才写）；bridge 脱敏生效（`"token":"[redacted]"`）。broker 日志显示设备客户端 `remote-ctrl-goldfish-1 (p2, c1, k30)`，k30 即代码里的 keepalive。

**环境陷阱（每条都已付过代价）**：
- 这个 build 的 NSH **不能用管道**，`ps | grep` 触发 `lib_fdcheck.c:92` 断言并打死 nsh_main，只能重启模拟器。
- `ai_agent` 必须**前台**运行，不能 `ai_agent &`——否则 NSH 抢 stdin，`set_remote` 落到 NSH 报 command not found。镜像有两个提示符：`goldfish-armv8a-ap>`（NSH）和 `vela>`（agent CLI）。
- guest eth0 = 10.0.2.15，网关 10.0.2.2；`rcS` 启动时**已经**做了 `ifup eth0`（我一度误判为需手动拉起）。
- bridge 权限超时 30 秒（`bridge-core.js:38`），超时后 prompt 被清、设备如实报「无待批准请求」，不是 bug。设备掉 Offline 同理源于 bridge `linkActive=false` 导致 `bridge-core.js:87` 吞掉 10 秒心跳（心跳在 `bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs:125-126`，不在 `src/`）。
- 日志必须放 `$HOME`，`/tmp` 下的会在工具调用之间消失。长任务用 `setsid nohup`，否则被工具超时连带杀掉。
- **`pkill -f` 内联执行会自匹配把当前 shell 杀掉**（本次踩了三次），要用方括号技巧 `[m]osquitto` 或 `pkill -x`。
- `set -o pipefail` + `strings 大文件 | grep -q`：grep 先退导致 strings 吃 SIGPIPE 返回 141，pipefail 误判为失败（实测 `pipeline exit=141`）。已改为缓存 strings 输出。
- `apps/packages` 是指向 `packages` 的符号链接，编译永远编 `packages/ai_agent` 而非 worktree，故需 stage 源码进去再还原（H47 教训：不要用符号链接调包）。
- **重要事故**：还原 vendor defconfig 时用了 `git checkout --`，而该文件本带用户未提交修改，被重置到 HEAD 抹掉。已按开工前备份精确还原（md5 `286a0e59`，`cmp` 字节一致），备份存于 `~/rc_defconfig_orig.bak`。此后脚本改用字节副本还原。
- CMake 对象名是 `<源>.c.o`（我一度用 `remote_agent.o` 匹配导致误判）。

**上游缺陷（不在本 feature 内，未修，留给用户定）**：NuttX `nuttx/drivers/crypto/dev_urandom.c:140` `return (uint32_t)nrand(65536L) << (uint32_t)nrand(65536L);` 移位量本身取 0..65535，≥32 在 ARM 上得 0，实测可用移位仅 0.046%，即 99.95% 输出为 0，导致 nonce 熵严重削弱（形如 `00004001000000d8...`）。上游该行上方自带 `REVISIT` 注释，本意应为 `<< 16`。解法：板级把 `CONFIG_DEV_URANDOM_CONGRUENTIAL=y` 换成 `CONFIG_DEV_URANDOM_XORSHIFT128=y`（本仓库已有 5 个板子用后者、仅 2 个用前者）。属 vendor 配置、影响该板所有 app，故未擅自改。**修正**：我最初判为「未初始化栈内存」是错的，`devurand_read` 会逐字写满缓冲区，那些 0 是 PRNG 真的返回 0。

**未验证部分**：tool 路径（`remote_agent_prompt` / `remote_agent_status`）完全没跑过，需配 LLM key；连带阻塞式 `remote_ctrl_channel_prompt()` 未执行；`remote_output` 一直为空（fake adapter 那轮无 agent 文本）；`remote_usage`、`remote_deny` 未执行；全部编译验证均为 host `gcc` + 打桩，NuttX 交叉编译只跑过 goldfish 这一个板。

## Accomplished

**已完成**：feature 全部代码写完（~3400 行新增 + 323 行改动既有文件），host 测试 5 组全过（`tests/host/run_remote_link_test.sh`），goldfish 编译成功并通过断言校验（6/6 对象、`CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y`、8 个版本唯一标记在 ELF 内、镜像 mtime 早于模拟器启动），端到端验证通过（见 Discoveries）。`packages/ai_agent` 与 vendor defconfig 均已还原干净（porcelain 0 / 回到原本 2 个脏文件）。镜像保留在 `cmake_out/remote-ctrl-verify`。

MEMORY-ai-agent-remote-ctrl.md (current focus).

- **remote-ctrl one-command runner: what real runs taught (2026-09-01, all measured on this box)**: (1) **`mimo acp --port N` BINDS that port, it does not dial an existing instance** — probe spawned `mimo acp --port 4187` and `ss -ltnp` showed a fresh LISTEN owned by it. `deskmate-bridge.mjs:51` passes `["acp","--port",N]` to the mimo adapter, so `--mimo-attach-port 4096` makes the bridge bind 4096. On any dev box already running mimo, **4096 is held by the host mimo — which on this machine is the parent process hosting the agent session (killing it ends the session)**. `scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh` now pre-checks and steps to the next free port (verified live: host kept 4096, bridge's spawn landed on 4097, both coexisted). The `port_free` regex requires `:` or `.` before the number because real `ss -ltn` output is full of rows whose Send-Q backlog is literally 4096. (2) **mimo's ACP side auto-approves tool calls, so a mimo-backed run CANNOT exercise human approval** — `remote_ask run git status in this repo` came back `bash` / `Run git status` / `tooluse_...: completed` with no `approval required` ever reaching the device, and `mimo acp --help` exposes no permission-mode flag (only port/hostname/mdns/cors/no-auth/cwd/pure/log). This bounds what a mimo demo can prove; it says nothing bad about the device code, since the fake backend closes the whole loop (`approval required` → `remote_once` → `Approved once.` → `Permission decision accepted by ACP` → latch refuses the repeat). Both `up`/`verify` help texts now state this instead of telling the user to wait for a request that never comes. (3) **`pkill -f <pattern>` executed inline self-matches the enclosing shell whenever the pattern text appears ANYWHERE in that shell's command line** — including in an earlier `setsid nohup …` line of the *same* inline script. Four incidents this session. The `[b]racket` trick only protects the pattern token itself, not other occurrences of the same text; kill by PID, or `pkill -x`. Symptom: the command dies mid-run leaving headless output. (4) **`set -o pipefail` + `<producer> | grep -q` is a false-failure generator**: grep exits at the first match, the producer takes SIGPIPE, the pipeline reports 141. Bit the image-marker assertion (`strings <230 MB image> | grep -qF` reported "marker missing" while the marker was present 4×, `pipeline exit=141` reproduced deliberately). Worse variant: `ip -4 addr … | grep -oP … | head -1` inside a function makes the whole function fail on a machine with no global address, killing the `10.0.2.2` fallback that was supposed to follow. Fix pattern: cache the producer's output once, feed grep a file or here-string. (5) `Billing:  / 13023 tokens` with an empty left slot is **BY DESIGN**, not a defect — `remote_link.c:514-515` plus the `remote_link.h:244` contract: an absent slot stays empty, never substitute zero, never price tokens. mimo reports tokens without a charge amount. I misfiled this as a bug once; don't re-open it. (6) Newly exercised this segment (previously in the unverified list): real-mimo end-to-end (handshake → `prompt_submit` → streamed reply → `Agent turn completed`, 4 s), plus `remote_output` (real agent text), `remote_status`, `remote_usage`. **Still unverified: `remote_deny`, and the two LLM-callable tools (`remote_agent_prompt`/`remote_agent_status`) with their blocking `remote_ctrl_channel_prompt()`.** (7) Teardown discipline that held: `down` restored `packages/ai_agent` to porcelain 0 and the board defconfig byte-identical to `~/rc_defconfig_orig.bak` (md5 `286a0e59…`, `cmp` clean, 0 occurrences of the feature flag).

一键脚本实跑验完了，`up` / `verify` 在 fake 和真 mimo 两个后端都走通，环境已停干净。

实跑抓到的问题比预期多，都不是镜像的问题：

pipefail 陷阱共三处，不是两处。除了你看到的镜像标记那处和 broker 检查那处，`detect_host_address` 里的 `ip … | grep -oP … | head -1` 更隐蔽——在没有全局 IP 的机器上整个函数会失败，而 `set -e` 会让脚本直接退出，**下一行那个 `10.0.2.2` 兜底永远轮不到执行**。三处都改成先缓存生产者输出再喂 grep。

两个健壮性缺口是靠实跑暴露的。一是 `start_bridge` 不像 `start_device` 那样查重，上一轮死在 marker 检查时 bridge 已经起来了还活着，重跑会起第二个 bridge 抢同一个 topic，两边都回 hello_ack；已加检查。二是 `--mimo-attach-port 4096`：我验证了 `mimo acp --port N` 是 **bind** 语义而非连接已有实例（拿 4187 起探针确认了 LISTEN），而这台机器上 4096 正被承载本会话的 mimo（pid 3442635，我的父进程）占着——真冲突，且那个进程绝对不能碰。现在改为预检后往后挪，实跑时宿主保住 4096、bridge 落到 4097，两者共存。

一处文案是错的，而且会让你白等。脚本原来教你在 mimo 下 `remote_ask run git status` 然后等权限请求，我照着跑了，结果是 `bash` / `Run git status` / `tooluse_…: completed`，设备侧压根没收到请求——mimo 的 ACP 自己批准了工具调用，`mimo acp --help` 里也没有任何权限模式开关。这不是设备侧缺陷，fake 后端能把整条回路闭合。`up` 和 `verify` 两处帮助文本都按实测改了，mimo 的 `verify` 也补了一步入向断言（实跑 4 秒闭合）。

#!/bin/bash

#
# Builds and runs the remote-control protocol test on the development host.
#
# The link, codec, and session layers are deliberately free of NuttX and MQTT
# dependencies, so they compile and run here. The MQTT transport and the channel
# are not covered: those need a board and a bridge.

set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
ROOT="$(cd "$HERE/../.." && pwd)"

# cJSON lives in the NuttX apps tree next to the package.
CJSON_DIR="${CJSON_DIR:-$ROOT/../../apps/netutils/cjson/cJSON}"
if [ ! -f "$CJSON_DIR/cJSON.c" ]; then
  echo "cJSON source not found at $CJSON_DIR" >&2
  echo "Set CJSON_DIR to the directory holding cJSON.c" >&2
  exit 1
fi

OUT="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT

# cJSON is third-party: compile it without the strict flags used for our code.
gcc -std=gnu11 -O1 -I "$CJSON_DIR" -c "$CJSON_DIR/cJSON.c" -o "$OUT/cJSON.o"

gcc -std=gnu11 -O1 -g \
  -Wall -Wextra -Werror \
  -I "$ROOT/src" -I "$CJSON_DIR" \
  "$ROOT/src/remote/remote_link.c" \
  "$ROOT/src/remote/remote_codec.c" \
  "$ROOT/src/remote/remote_session.c" \
  "$HERE/test_remote_link.c" \
  "$OUT/cJSON.o" \
  -lpthread \
  -o "$OUT/test_remote_link"

"$OUT/test_remote_link"

## MQTT Channel

通过 MQTT 协议接入，适用于 IoT 设备集成。基于 MQTT-C 库。

### 配置

```bash
vela> set_mqtt <broker-host>:1883
```

### 使用示例

```bash
# 在主机上订阅回复 topic
mosquitto_sub -h <broker-host> -t "agent/out" -v

# 在主机上发送消息
mosquitto_pub -h <broker-host> -t "agent/in" \
  -m '{"type":"message","content":"现在几点了？","chat_id":"device1"}'
```

text:
明白了,你要的是设备上正式跑起来那套,不是 host 单测。和你原来跑 deskmate 完全同构——broker 和 bridge 一样都要开,只是设备侧那条 `deskmate ...` 换成 `ai_agent` 里的 `set_remote`。

## 1. 编译(带上开关)

`CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL` 是 `default n`,得先开(menuconfig 里在 Vela AI Agent 下,或直接往 `vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/defconfig` 加一行 `CONFIG_AI_AGENT_REMOTE_CTRL=y`),依赖 `NETUTILS_MQTTC` + `NETUTILS_CJSON`,goldfish 上都已经是 y。

```bash
./build.sh vendor/openvela/boards/vela/configs/goldfish-arm64-v8a-ap/ --cmake -b cmake_out/remote-ctrl -j$(nproc)
```

## 2. 主机:bridge(和你原来那条一字不差)

```bash
export DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME=deskmate DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD=5006
cd contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/tools/acp-bridge
bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge mimo mqtt \
  --broker mqtt://10.189.140.244:1883 --device-id goldfish-1 \
  --mimo-attach --mimo-attach-port 4096
```

broker 就用你现有的 1883,不用另起。

## 3. 设备:NSH 里三条命令

```bash
./emulator.sh cmake_out/remote-ctrl -no-window
```

```
ai_agent                                    # 必须前台,别加 &
set_remote_auth deskmate 5006
set_remote 10.189.140.244:1883 goldfish-1
```

`set_remote` 对应你原来 `deskmate -h ... -p ... -d ...` 那条,凭据拆到 `set_remote_auth`,两者都落盘(`remote_broker` / `remote_device_id` / `remote_username` / `remote_password` / `remote_topic_prefix`),**下次开机不用重设**——这是和 deskmate 每次带 argv 不同的地方。

## 4. 怎么看它通了

设备侧打 `remote_status`,`Chat turns: yes` 就是握手成功。然后:

```
remote_ask 看一下这个仓库现在的分支
remote_output          # agent 回复
remote_usage           # 刷新计费
remote_once/remote_deny  # 有待批准请求时,人工决策
```

想看线上报文(topic 和 deskmate 同一套,前缀默认 `deskmate`):

```bash
mosquitto_sub -h 10.189.140.244 -p 1883 -u deskmate -P 5006 -t 'deskmate/#' -v
```

发 `deskmate/goldfish-1/device-to-bridge`,收 `deskmate/goldfish-1/bridge-to-device`,client id `remote-ctrl-goldfish-1`,keepalive 30。

## 5. 或者一条命令

上面这些我封进脚本了,`up` 就是 broker 探测 + bridge + 模拟器 + 三条设备命令全做完:

```bash
export DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME=deskmate DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD=5006
./scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh build     # 自动开 Kconfig、编完断言镜像里真有这个 feature
./scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh up
./scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh verify    # 自动断言
./scripts/remote-ctrl-demo.sh down      # 还原 defconfig 和 packages/ai_agent
```

两个实测坑值得先知道。一是 **mimo 后端看不到权限请求**:它的 ACP 侧自己批准工具调用,我拿 `remote_ask run git status in this repo` 试过,回来直接 `tooluse_...: completed`,设备压根没被问,`mimo acp --help` 里也没有权限模式开关。要验 `remote_once` / `remote_deny` 得用 `REMOTE_CTRL_BACKEND=fake`。二是 **4096 可能被你自己正在跑的 mimo 占着**(`mimo acp --port N` 是 bind 不是连已有实例),脚本会自动往后挪到 4097。

这套东西 README 和 `docs/channels.md` 里一个字都没有,所以你只能来问我——要不要我按 `docs/channels.md` 现有通道的格式补一节进去?
